KAPPASTWEAKS-CHAINED.title: Chained
KAPPASTWEAKS-CHAINED.description: When a domino matches one of your open ends, it Chains: its bonus triggers and that end becomes its other pip. Blank (0) matches anything. A domino that matches neither end breaks the chain and its pips become your new open ends.
KAPPASTWEAKS-JUMBLED.title: Jumbled
KAPPASTWEAKS-JUMBLED.description: This card's pips are rerolled every time it is drawn.
KAPPASTWEAKS-LOOSE.title: Loose
KAPPASTWEAKS-LOOSE.description: This domino also [gold]Chains[/gold] with open ends 1 higher or lower.
